messages:
Asha: FYI incoming from Acme EU — invoice INV-2026-459 placed on HOLD during invoice creation. Reason shown in billing UI: VAT_EXEMPT_UNVERIFIED + MISSING_PO. Customer uploaded resale_certificate.pdf and says VAT ID is DE123456789.
Jordan: Billing logs show automated VIES check returned NAME_MISMATCH for DE123456789, so system flagged for manual review. Also customer attempted to pay with card but it declined with code 402_card_declined; payment retried twice.
FinanceBot: Auto-hold created: invoice_id=INV-2026-459; hold_reasons=[VAT_ID_UNVERIFIED,MISSING_PO,CARD_DECLINE]; created_by=system; timestamp=2000123456
Asha: Repro steps I followed:
1) POST /invoices create body {"account_id":"acct_acme_eu","vat_id":"DE123456789","po_number":""}
2) Billing service calls /tax/validate -> 422 {"error":"name_mismatch","source":"vies"}
3) UI displays require_evidence modal -> customer uploaded resale_certificate.pdf
Jordan: Screenshot of billing logs attached. The VIES response included this:
```
{"countryCode":"DE","vatNumber":"123456789","requestDate":"2026-03-14+01:00","valid":false,"name":"ACME GMBH LTD","address":"..."}
```
Liam: @Asha can you confirm the exact VAT ID string customer entered? VIES sometimes strips leading zeros and our normalize step might mismatch. Also need to check if they used an EU branch id (e.g., DE123... vs DE123/BR).
Asha: They pasted 'DE123456789' in the form. Customer insists the ID is correct and provided a scanned resale certificate that shows DE 123456789 and company name 'Acme GmbH'.
Marcos: I chatted w/ the customer. They say PO # is required by their AP team; they need invoice to include PO before they can do bank transfer. They want the VAT hold removed so they can get the PDF to their AP team.
Liam: We can't remove VAT verification entirely. Options: (1) manual override confirming VAT id after reviewing certificate + evidence -> mark as VAT_EXEMPT and release hold; (2) ask AP to provide company registration extract or VIES screenshot; (3) accept payment and refund if necessary.
Jordan: For manual override, finance needs: copy of resale cert, proof of business registry search, and confirm the PO string to add. If you hand this to me I can process.
Asha: Customer attached resale_certificate.pdf and registry_extract.jpg in the ticket. I can forward to you, Jordan. Can you confirm if you can also clear the MISSING_PO hold if I add PO value 'PO-7421' from customer? They need the invoice PDF ASAP.
Jordan: I can add PO to invoice and remove MISSING_PO hold. For VAT_EXEMPT we need Liam to confirm. @Liam any ETA to review docs?
Liam: I'll review now. If the name mismatch is only casing or punctuation I'll accept. If VIES returns valid:false we still accept manual override for known enterprise customers. Give me ~30m.
FinanceBot: Payment retry scheduled in 2h; note if manual override occurs before retry we can halt retries.
Asha: Thanks all — I'll upload PO-7421 and forward the docs to Jordan and Liam. I'll post update here once cleared.
Marcos: Customer grateful. tagging legal if anything odd: @Liam @Jordan
